statements.name: Measles primary series is complete.
statements.activityTypeValue: Measles primary series is complete. Two measles primary series doses were administered. Check if a measles supplementary dose is appropriate for the client.
statements.rationale: An additional dose of MCV should be administered to HIV-infected children receiving HAART following immune reconstitution. If CD4+ T lymphocyte counts are monitored, an additional dose of MCV should be administered when immune reconstitution has been achieved, e.g. when the CD4+ T lymphocyte count reaches 20–25%. Where CD4+ T lymphocyte monitoring is not available, children should receive an additional dose of MCV 6–12 months after initiation of HAART.

statements.rationale: An additional dose of MCV should be administered to HIV-infected children receiving HAART following immune reconstitution. If CD4+ T lymphocyte counts are monitored, an additional dose of MCV should be administered when immune reconstitution has been achieved, e.g. when the CD4+ T lymphocyte count reaches 20–25%. Where CD4+ T lymphocyte monitoring is not available, children should receive an additional dose of MCV 6–12 months after initiation of HAART.

statements.name: Check Contraindication for Measles Immunization
statements.rationale:
While vaccines are universally recommended, some clients may have contraindications to particular vaccines.
Additional contraindications may be included in WHO position papers for the vaccine - Measles vaccines: WHO position paper (April 2017).
